chapter.p: Mankind will be judged for what they have done while on earth during their mortal life. If they were to die in their wickedness, they would be outcast from spiritual things involving righteousness and brought to stand before God to be judged for what they did. If the things they did involve filthy thoughts and behavior, they’ll certainly be filthy, and it would be impossible for them to live in God’s kingdom, because God’s kingdom would become polluted and filthy as well. But God’s kingdom isn’t filthy, and no unclean thing can enter God’s kingdom. See 1 Nephi 4:6 CE. See also SIN; INIQUITY.
